Eurometal predicts 300,000 job losses in manufacturing in the rest of 2026 because of expanding competition from China, which is now enjoying a record €1bn-a-day trade surplus with the bloc. Continue reading...

The prophet Amos declared, "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!" This call for justice echoes in the concerns of workers facing displacement and...
reflection.zh: 由于来自中国的激烈竞争，欧盟制造业可能损失30万个工作岗位的警告，引发了关于经济公正和公平的深刻问题。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”（阿摩司书5:24）这种对公正的呼唤，在面对失业和经济困境的工人们的担忧中得到了回响。

title.en: China prepares £40bn stimulus for financial sector amid fears over sluggish growth

The funds will come from state institutions and are intended to help replenish cash reserves and bolster investment in the stock market.
summary.zh: 北京计划向其金融业注入540亿美元（400亿英镑），旨在支持银行和保险公司应对经济增长乏力的问题。这笔资金将来自国家机构，用于补充现金储备并提振股市投资。

body.en: Beijing wants banks and insurers to bolster investment in stock market as it helps to replenish cash reserves China will inject $54bn (£40bn) into its financial sector as Beijing attempts to shore up banks and insurers in the face of faltering economic growth. A host of financial institutions said they were due to receive billions of yuan in capital from state institutions including the ministry of finance and even the company that runs the country’s tobacco monopoly. Continue reading...
body.zh: 北京希望银行和保险公司加强对股市的投资，以帮助补充现金储备 随着北京试图在经济增长放缓的情况下支撑银行和保险公司，中国将向其金融部门注资 540 亿美元（400 亿英镑）。许多金融机构表示，它们将从财政部甚至烟草专卖公司等国家机构获得数十亿元人民币的资金。继续阅读...

The prophet Micah reminds us that true governance involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that...

title.en: The world is being driven to the brink by thugs and dictators, but there is a route to a brighter future | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 世界被暴徒和独裁者推向边缘，但通往更光明未来的道路依然存在

summary.en: The article posits that the world is currently facing numerous crises, including unending wars, humanitarian emergencies, rising authoritarianism, economic inequality, and climate breakdown, leading some analysts to believe we are in the midst of a third world war. However, it suggests that ordinary people possess...
summary.zh: 文章认为，世界正面临着无数危机，包括无休止的战争、人道主义紧急状况、日益增长的威权主义、经济不平等和气候崩溃，一些分析人士甚至认为我们正处于第三次世界大战之中。然而，文章也指出，普通人拥有比他们想象中更大的力量，可以引领世界走向更光明的未来。

body.en: It’s no surprise some analysts say we are already in the midst of the third world war, but ordinary people have more power than we think Don’t look up! The world is a mess. The sky could fall in any day. Unending wars, expanding humanitarian crises, rising authoritarianism, dysfunctional democracies, rampant racial and religious extremism, and unchecked lawlessness cast a dark cloud as the west’s new political year begins. Set all that against a backdrop of staggering global economic inequality, corporate and individual greed, irresponsible government indebtedness, dangerous AI gambles, climate breakdown and proliferating nuclear weapons, and a truly apocalyptic global outlook begins to take shape. It’s enough to make anyone shut their eyes, cover their ears and utter a Munch-like scream. And it’s only getting worse. Democratic leaders who promise a better, safer, more optimistic future – what Britain’s freshly arrived prime minister, Andy Burnham, calls a “ new era of possibility ” – cannot escape this wider international context. Last week’s global bond market upheaval , sparked by external factors, left Burnham’s cash-strapped government struggling with sharply increased borrowing costs before he barely got started. The fact he chose Ukraine for his first overseas trip, while symbolically important, highlighted another grim reality. As a lead opponent of Vladimir Putin’s invasion, Britain now finds itself in a de facto state of war with Russia – and facing attack. Argentina, too, is eyeing UK defence vulnerabilities . These are not the sort of possibilities Burnham envisaged. Continue reading...
body.zh: 毫不奇怪，一些分析人士说，我们已经处于第三次世界大战之中，但普通人拥有比我们想象的更多的力量，不要抬头！世界一团糟。天随时可能塌下来。无休无止的战争、不断扩大的人道主义危机、日益抬头的威权主义、功能失调的民主国家、猖獗的种族和宗教极端主义以及不受约束的违法行为，在西方新的政治一年开始之际，蒙上了一层乌云。在全球经济严重不平等、企业和个人贪婪、不负责任的政府债务、危险的人工智能赌博、气候崩溃和核武器扩散的背景下，真正的世界末日般的全球前景开始形成。这足以让任何人闭上眼睛，捂住耳朵，发出蒙克式的尖叫声。而且情况只会变得更糟。民主党领导人许诺一个更好、更安全、更乐观的未来 — — 英国新任首相安迪·伯纳姆称之为“充满可能性的新时代” — — 无法摆脱这个更广泛的国际背景。上周由外部因素引发的全球债券市场动荡，让资金短缺的伯纳姆政府在刚刚开始执政之前就陷入了借贷成本急剧上升的困境。他选择乌克兰作为他的第一次海外访问，虽然具有重要的象征意义，但也凸显了另一个严峻的现实。作为弗拉基米尔·普京入侵的主要反对者，英国现在发现自己与俄罗斯处于事实上的战争状态 — — 并面临攻击。阿根廷也正在关注英国国防的弱点。这些不是伯纳姆设想的那种可能性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author paints a grim picture of global affairs, citing 'thugs and dictators' and 'unending wars' as driving forces toward a precipice. In such times, the temptation to despair or retaliate can be strong. Yet, the call remains to actively choose good over evil, refusing to be consumed by the darkness, and instead, to embody hope and constructive action.
reflection.zh: 作者描绘了一幅严峻的全球局势图景，指出“暴徒和独裁者”以及“无休止的战争”正将世界推向悬崖边缘。在这样的时代，绝望或报复的诱惑可能很强烈。然而，我们仍然被呼召要积极地以善胜恶，拒绝被黑暗吞噬，而是要体现希望和建设性的行动。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: How Australia hopes to help the nation that's accused China of 'weaponising tourism'
title.zh: 中国被指控影响太平洋的方式出人意料

summary.en: As Palau faces renewed criticism from China, its president is seeking Australian assistance to diversify its primary economic source, tourism.
summary.zh: 在帕劳再次面临中国的批评之际，其总统正寻求澳大利亚的援助，以实现其主要经济来源——旅游业的多元化。

body.en:
As our boat bobs along clear turquoise waters, the local operator hands us snorkelling masks. You don't need them, though, to see a stunning coral reef and schools of vibrant fish surrounded by historic limestone islands.

In a nearby lake, we swim under the hot sun and among hundreds of jellyfish, some tickling our legs and arms. They're harmless, Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr, had earlier assured us.

Whipps, fresh from hosting a highly charged Pacific Islands Forum, proudly points to the postcard landscape behind him: "This is my office", he declares.

It's in Palau, a Micronesian nation dotting the western Pacific, with a population of just 18,000, that China has triggered its sting. The reason: Palau is one of just 12 countries in the world to formally recognise Taiwan, a decision that has long angered Beijing, but its wrath was felt on the global stage this week.

Just days before 2,000 people were expected to converge on the island for the 55th Pacific Islands Forum leaders' meeting, China issued a travel advisory to its residents, warning them of "theft" and "a dangerous local marine environment".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Whipps said it was "unfortunate" that Beijing was "weaponising tourism", an industry Palau is heavily reliant on. More than 40 per cent of its GDP comes from the tourism industry.

"We live in a free world. We should enjoy each other's treasures and treat each other with respect, and I hope that the people in China see that," Whipps said.

"Maybe [Chinese] leadership has a different opinion, but at the end of the day, we're all people of this one planet, and we care about each other."

Palau's ambassador to Taiwan Gaafar Uherbelau says this isn't the first time China has used tourism to respond to diplomatic spats.

"We saw a peak in Chinese tourists that came in, and then all of a sudden we saw a plunge due to this ongoing tension that we got caught in between," Uherbelau says.

In 2015, Palau boasted more than 165,000 visitors from around the world, and more than 91,000 of them came from China alone. Last year, total visitors were just two-thirds of that number, recording just 65,558 people.

But in November 2017, the Chinese government ended chartered flights to the island and ordered tour operators to stop selling package tours to Palau, in what was unofficially known as a "tourism ban". By 2019, Palau's total visitor numbers had halved to just 85,000 and tourism from China plummeted by 63 per cent.

Despite the CCP's efforts, Chinese visitors are slowly increasing post-pandemic, with many instead taking flights to Palau via Hong Kong.

"We've learned to be more resilient against these different shocks...

title.en: Can communities be proteced from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 社区能否免受冰川融化的影响？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 日益升高的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明，迫切需要解决方案以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The melting glaciers and subsequent disasters in Nepal and Tibet are a stark reminder that our planet groans under the weight of human activity. Romans 8:22 speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting its redemption. This passage calls us to acknowledge the deep interconnectedness of our world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏融化的冰川及随之而来的灾难，鲜明地提醒我们，我们的地球在人类活动的重压下呻吟。罗马书8:22说，万物一同叹息劳苦，等候得赎。这段经文呼吁我们认识到我们世界深层的相互联系，以及我们照顾它的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水图像

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后发生了数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则向各大平台推送官方内容。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The devastating flood in Tibet and Nepal serves as a stark reminder of nature's power and the vulnerability of human communities. In the aftermath, the swift erasure of visual evidence by Chinese censors highlights a different kind of disaster – the suppression of truth and the manipulation of information. This digital crackdown, while obscuring the reality...
reflection.zh: 西藏和尼泊尔发生的毁灭性洪水，有力地提醒着人们大自然的力量以及人类社区的脆弱性。灾难过后，中国审查人员迅速抹去视觉证据，揭示了另一种灾难——真相的压制和信息的操纵。这种数字审查虽然对某些人来说掩盖了实际灾难的真相，但最终却损害了信任，阻碍了真诚的理解和同情。

verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

summary.en: New laws could let you switch off your feed's algorithm — but how is the real question.
summary.zh: 新法律可能允许您关闭信息流的算法——但如何实现才是真正的问题。

body.en:
Your morning scroll could look very different under new draft laws from the federal government, which plan to give social media users the chance to switch off the algorithm shaping their feed.

An exposure draft of the long-awaited Digital Duty of Care is expected this week, which will put the onus on platforms to risk-test their products before rolling them out — with one proposed measure forcing social media giants to let users opt out of the recommender systems that decide what content they see.

But the plan is already facing pushback, with the Coalition and the Greens both flagging problems with the approach from opposite directions, while other experts have welcomed the change but say the devil is in the detail.

Under the new laws, platforms will be required to offer an opt-out from algorithm-driven feeds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Communications Minister Anika Wells says the goal is choice, not a ban on algorithms altogether.

"A lot of Australians appreciate the algorithm, both for the enjoyment that they get out of it or the utility that they get out of it," she told ABC News on Monday morning, adding that big tech should "offer them the choice in the first place" and "respect that choice".

Companies could be fined up to $109.2 million for breaching the wider duty of care laws, which also require platforms to actively mitigate risks on their platforms.

"People can already opt out of algorithms in their accounts. Why do we need the government here?" he said on Monday morning, accusing the government of using the policy to "silence people" from engaging with content critical of it.

But existing options to opt out of the algorithm are harder to use than that suggests.

"It's not true that you can opt out of recommender systems on all platforms," Tama Leaver, professor of internet studies at Curtin University, told SBS News.

On Instagram for instance, users can toggle to a followers-only feed, he says, but it snaps back to the algorithmic version every time they log back in. A different setting that lets users snooze certain personalised content resets every month.

Where opt-outs do exist, he said they're often "buried" in menus, requiring a "deep dive" to find them.

"The question of what you will get instead is the thing that will decide whether people will try this out or not," Leaver told SBS News.

He said a return to a reverse chronological feed — the model Instagram launched with — would show only posts from accounts you follow, in the order they were posted, and you could reach the end of your feed — rather than today's endless scroll.

But that's a harder sell than it sounds. Fewer people...
body.zh: 根据联邦政府的新法律草案，你的早间滚动可能看起来非常不同，该法律计划让社交媒体用户有机会关闭塑造其信息流的算法。 期待已久的数字谨慎责任草案预计将于本周发布，该草案将让平台有责任在推出产品之前对其产品进行风险测试，其中一项拟议措施迫使社交媒体巨头让用户选择退出决定他们看到什么内容的推荐系统。 但该计划已经面临阻力，联盟党和绿党都从相反的方向指出了这一做法的问题，而其他专家则对这一变化表示欢迎，但表示问题在于细节。 根据新法律，平台将被要求提供从算法驱动的源中选择退出的功能。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 通信部长阿尼卡·威尔斯表示，目标是选择，而不是完全禁止算法。 她周一早上告诉美国广播公司新闻，“许多澳大利亚人都很欣赏这种算法，无论是因为他们从中获得的乐趣，还是因为他们从中获得的效用”，并补充说大型科技公司应该“首先为他们提供选择”并“尊重这种选择”。 公司可能因违反更广泛的注意义务法而被处以最高 1.092 亿美元的罚款，该法还要求平台积极降低其平台上的风险。 “人们已经可以选择退出账户中的算法。为什么我们需要政府？”他周一上午表示，指责政府利用该政策“压制人们”参与批评政府的内容。 但现有的退出该算法的选项比所暗示的更难使用。 科廷大学互联网研究教授 Tama Leaver 告诉 SBS 新闻：“并不是说你可以在所有平台上选择退出推荐系统。” 他说，例如在 Instagram 上，用户可以切换到仅限关注者的提要，但每次重新登录时，它都会快速返回到算法版本。允许用户暂停某些个性化内容的不同设置每月都会重置。 他说，在确实存在选择退出的情况下，它们通常“埋藏”在菜单中，需要“深入研究”才能找到它们。 利弗告诉 SBS 新闻：“你会得到什么的问题将决定人们是否会尝试这一点。” 他表示，回归逆时间顺序推送（Instagram 推出的模型）将只显示您关注的帐户中的帖子，按照发布的顺序，并且您可以到达推送的末尾，而不是今天的无休止的滚动。 但这比听起来更难。人少了...

reflection.en: The proposal to allow users to opt out of social media algorithms raises questions about how we curate our digital environment. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, and praiseworthy. As we navigate the complexities of online content, may we seek to fill our minds with that which...
reflection.zh: 允许用户选择退出社交媒体算法的提议，引发了关于我们如何管理数字环境的问题。《腓立比书》4:8 鼓励我们将心思意念专注于凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，若有什么德行，若有什么称赞，这些事。当我们应对在线内容的复杂性时，愿我们寻求用那能造就我们并反映雅伟良善的事物来充实我们的思想，而不是那些使我们分心或受伤的事物。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Homebuyers left in the dark as embattled property developer Bathla confirms major lay-offs
title.zh: 陷入困境的房产开发商Bathla确认大规模裁员，购房者陷入不明朗境地

summary.en: Bathla is among a long list of Australian home developers that have recently entered voluntary administration or liquidation.
summary.zh: Bathla是近期进入自愿管理或清算的众多澳大利亚房屋开发商之一。

body.en:
Property developer Bathla Group has stood down almost two-thirds of its workforce following its entry into voluntary administration earlier this year.

About 213 of Bathla's 350 staff were stood down at a meeting in Sydney on Monday morning, and construction on several projects has halted as the embattled firm clings to life.

Bathla is one of Sydney's largest residential developers, with 45 projects under construction.

Administrators said they had secured short-term funding to keep some of the firm's projects going.

Insolvency adviser Teneo announced it had secured the funding through five lenders linked to the projects, but the amounts and participants were kept confidential.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Administrator Stephen Longley said the funding would enable Bathla Group to maintain limited operations for a further two weeks while longer-term solutions were explored.

"Our immediate priority has been to secure sufficient short-term funding to maintain a minimum viable operating structure," he said.

"The arrangements agreed allow us to provide the central support required for construction to continue on projects associated with the lenders participating in the funding package.

"Significant work remains to secure the funding required to progress and ultimately complete all projects currently under construction. We will continue to work closely with lenders and other key stakeholders to pursue those arrangements."

NSW Premier Chris Minns said the government was talking with administrators, but defended not spending public money bailing out the Sydney-based business.

Minns described Bathla's corporate structure as strange and highly reliant on debt from private lenders.

"I can't just hand money over to an administrator, particularly when the finances of this particular firm are so opaque and difficult to decipher," Minns said.

"There's been a lot of commentary about the way this company ... was managed and run, particularly the enormous amount of debt it ran up.

"This is a very strange corporate structure involving a hell of a lot of debt, largely collected from private credit, not through the banks and traditional finances."

Figures presented to creditors put Bathla's total debt at $3.4 billion, including $3.08 billion to secured lenders, $130 million to unsecured lenders, $145 million to the tax office and $4 million to employees.

The home developer entered voluntary administration in late August after the NSW government declined to bail it out.

Former NSW building commissioner David Chandler said issues with Bathla were widely known and called the firm a "slow-moving trainwreck".

title.en: The $25,000 loss critics warn lies under One Nation's superannuation plan
title.zh: 2.5万澳元的损失：批评者警告“国家党”养老金计划下的隐患

summary.en: One Nation has proposed a policy allowing workers to divert 3% of their superannuation payments to their immediate income for up to three years, a move critics argue could lead to significant financial losses for individuals in retirement and increased costs for future taxpayers.
summary.zh: “国家党”提出了一项政策，允许工人在最多三年内将养老金缴款的3%直接用于即时收入，批评者认为此举可能导致个人退休后财务状况严重受损，并增加未来纳税人的负担。

body.en:
One Nation's plan to allow workers to extract part of their superannuation as take-home-pay could leave Australians poorer in retirement while charging future taxpayers more, experts and critics warn.

One Nation has proposed changes to superannuation that would allow workers paying rent or a mortgage to divert 3 per cent of their super payments straight to their wallet for up to three years — investing only 9 per cent instead of the current compulsory rate of 12 per cent.

Employers would still contribute 12 per cent, but the nominated super fund would invest only 9 per cent — paying out 3 per cent to the customer.

Payments would be taxed at the concessional rate of 15 per cent rather than the personal income tax rate.

Party leader Pauline Hanson said the policy would give households "breathing room" and would help people to buy groceries, power bills and the costs of raising a family.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"For a full-time worker earning about $90,500, that means around $2,300 a year after tax, or $44 a week, extra in their pocket," she said.

"For a working couple earning $168,000 between them, it is about $4,300 a year after tax, or $82 a week, back in the family budget.

But the policy has been criticised for its potential impact on retirement, with some saying it could leave thousands worse off later in life.

Mardy Chiah, associate professor of finance at the University of Newcastle's School of Business, estimated that it would result in a loss of about $23,000 to $24,000 in invested income.

"If you're earning an average $90,000 salary, the 3 per cent would give you an extra $2,300 a year — which after three years would be $6,900," Chiah said, explaining the calculation.

"This policy essentially gives households more financial breathing room today in exchange for ... much less money invested for their retirement.

"The loss can be quite substantial. You're taking money away from your future self."

A similar loss was projected by the Super Members Council's analysis of the policy, which said a 30-year-old full-time worker on a salary of $90,500 who opts into One Nation's policy would be down $25,000 in retirement superannuation.

The same 30-year-old worker would lose over $18,000 in compounding interest by the time they reach the retirement age of 67.

Super Members Council CEO Misha Schubert said the scheme would damage a person's super and retirement and increase "inflation and interest rates — which would make cost-of-living pressures even worse".

title.en: Qantas flight makes priority landing after engine issue sparks panic over New Zealand
title.zh: 澳航航班因引擎故障紧急降落，新西兰上空引发恐慌

summary.en: Qantas has sent two engineers to Christchurch to investigate the incident. Emergency services were called to the tarmac when a Qantas flight made a priority landing in Christchurch after an engine issue, which one passenger described as 'traumatic'.
summary.zh: 澳航已派两名工程师前往基督城调查此次事件。一架澳航航班因引擎出现问题后紧急降落基督城，一名乘客称此次经历“创伤性”，紧急服务人员随即赶往停机坪。

body.en:
Emergency services were called to the tarmac when a Qantas flight made a priority landing in Christchurch after an engine issue, which one passenger described as "traumatic".

Liza-Jayne Loch was returning home from a business trip to New Zealand when the Qantas flight ran into trouble.

The plane was climbing above the scenic South Island's mountain ranges on Saturday afternoon, bound for Sydney, when a bang shook the cabin.

A passenger seated nearest the left wing soon shouted, "the engine's on fire", Loch recalled, as the cabin lights began to flicker.

Footage recorded by a passenger and shared with AAP shows flames appearing to issue from the plane's left engine in a series of rapid bursts.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I was sitting on the left-hand side of the plane, and the flames were very, very visible," Loch said.

As the plane continued to gain altitude, Loch tried to comfort herself by recalling that modern jets could land safely on a single engine.

"That's what I kept in my head, that we could actually fly on one engine," she said.

QF122 suffered a suspected engine issue shortly after taking off from Queenstown on Saturday afternoon, before making a priority landing at Christchurch.

According to Flight Aware, the Boeing 737 landed about 52 minutes after take-off, touching down shortly before 5pm local time.

The cause of the incident has yet to be determined, but Qantas sent two engineers to Christchurch on Sunday to investigate.

Both engines are thought to have remained in operation for the duration of the flight.

Loch said conditions soon stabilised after the initial shock, while cabin staff took pains to comfort passengers.

Emergency services were waiting on the tarmac when the flight landed, and passengers were allowed to disembark as normal after a short wait.

A Qantas spokesperson said the plane was believed to have suffered an engine issue and steps would be taken to support affected customers.

"Our pilots are highly trained to manage situations like this and the aircraft landed safely," they said.

"We know this would have been a distressing experience for passengers and will be contacting all customers to provide support."

Affected passengers were put up in a hotel near the Christchurch International Airport before being booked on a complimentary flight to Sydney on Sunday.

While the second flight went off without a hitch, Loch said nerves were still high.

body.zh: 当澳洲航空的一架航班在发动机出现问题后优先降落在基督城时，紧急服务人员被呼叫到停机坪，一名乘客称这是“创伤性的”。 丽莎-杰恩·洛克 (Liza-Jayne Loch) 正在从新西兰出差回家时，澳洲航空的航班遇到了麻烦。 周六下午，这架飞机正在风景秀丽的南岛山脉上空爬升，飞往悉尼，突然一声巨响震动了机舱。 洛赫回忆说，当机舱灯光开始闪烁时，坐在最靠近左翼的一名乘客很快就喊道：“发动机着火了”。 一名乘客录制并与 AAP 分享的视频显示，火焰似乎从飞机的左侧发动机中快速喷出。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我坐在飞机的左侧，火焰非常非常明显，”洛克说。 随着飞机继续上升，洛克试图安慰自己，回忆起现代喷气式飞机可以通过单引擎安全着陆。 “这就是我一直牢记在心的事情，我们实际上可以用一台发动机来飞行，”她说。 QF122 周六下午从皇后镇起飞后不久就疑似出现发动机问题，随后优先降落在基督城。 据 Flight Aware 报道，这架波音 737 飞机在起飞后约 52 分钟着陆，在当地时间下午 5 点前不久着陆。 事件原因尚未确定，但澳洲航空已于周日派出两名工程师前往基督城进行调查。 据信，这两个发动机在飞行期间一直保持运转。 洛克表示，在最初的震惊之后，情况很快就稳定下来，而机舱工作人员则煞费苦心地安抚乘客。 航班降落时，紧急服务人员正在停机坪上等待，短暂等待后，乘客被允许正常下机。 澳航发言人表示，据信这架飞机出现了发动机问题，将采取措施支持受影响的客户。 他们说：“我们的飞行员训练有素，能够应对此类情况，飞机安全着陆。” “我们知道这对乘客来说将是一次痛苦的经历，我们将联系所有乘客提供支持。” 受影响的乘客被安置在基督城国际机场附近的一家酒店，然后被预订周日飞往悉尼的免费航班。 洛克表示，虽然第二次航班顺利起飞，但人们仍然高度紧张。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The sudden fear and trauma experienced by passengers on the Qantas flight highlight how quickly our sense of security can be shattered. In moments of unexpected crisis, the heart can feel broken by fear and uncertainty. Yet, even in such distress, there is a divine promise of healing and restoration for those who are hurting.

title.en: 'Now measured in the millions': The common process being used to scam Australians
title.zh: “现在以数百万计”：欺骗澳大利亚人的常见过程

summary.en: Scammers are getting creative as AI presents new opportunities.
summary.zh: 随着人工智能带来新的机遇，诈骗者正变得越来越有创意。

body.en:
CAPTCHAs are meant to protect our online infrastructure from bots. Scammers, however, are turning them against us.

Cybersecurity experts have seen a rise in fake CAPTCHA scams, with the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) releasing a warning this week about the ruse.

The fake CAPTCHAs direct internet users to input code outside of their browser, which grants hackers access to the device and, in some cases, browser session information.

The scams often ask them to paste a script into a computer's terminal, allowing the attacks to bypass anti-malware security systems.

Hammond Pearce, senior lecturer at UNSW School of Computer Science and managing director of the Digital Lies & Cyber Literacy Foundation, said the ability to bypass anti-malware protections made fake CAPTCHA scams particularly dangerous.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"You haven't got very many of the protections of the operating system working for you," he told SBS News.

Previously, CAPTCHAs were commonly required for creating online account. However, they're now common when making the first connection with a website, greatly increasing the number that internet users are asked to complete.

Pearce attributes this to "the explosion of AI agents online" as websites attempt to prevent artificial intelligence from going through them.

The increased prevalence of CAPTCHAs means it's easier for dodgy ones to slip through.

Pearce said he'd "expect it more on slightly dodgier websites" but hackers "can try and hijack your connection so that you get that when you're trying to get to a normal website".

Pearce also said the number of fake CAPTCHA attacks "are now measured in the millions".

According to Pearce, it's now much harder than it used to be for criminals to leverage a person's internet connection against them.

Major browsers such as Chrome, Firefox and Edge have used significant resources to make themselves "about the safest piece of technology there is on your computer", Pearce said.

He said users should be suspicious if a CAPTCHA asks them to type something or leave the window.

"If it's actually asking you to type some random thing on your keyboard, you should immediately start getting suspicious," Pearce said.

"Be very wary of anything that might take you out of the safety of the web browser."

He says that, if something feels off, internet users should ask themselves: "Why? Why do I need to do this?"

body.zh: 验证码旨在保护我们的在线基础设施免受机器人攻击。然而，骗子正在利用他们来对付我们。 网络安全专家发现假冒验证码骗局有所增加，澳大利亚信号局 (ASD) 本周针对这一骗局发布了警告。 假冒的验证码引导互联网用户在浏览器外部输入代码，这使黑客能够访问设备，在某些情况下还可以访问浏览器会话信息。 这些骗局通常要求他们将脚本粘贴到计算机终端中，从而允许攻击绕过反恶意软件安全系统。 新南威尔士大学计算机科学学院高级讲师兼数字谎言和网络素养基金会董事总经理哈蒙德·皮尔斯表示，绕过反恶意软件保护的能力使得虚假验证码诈骗变得尤其危险。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他告诉 SBS 新闻：“你还没有得到太多适合你的操作系统保护。” 以前，创建在线帐户通常需要验证码。然而，它们现在在首次连接网站时很常见，大大增加了互联网用户被要求完成的数量。 皮尔斯将此归因于“在线人工智能代理的爆炸式增长”，因为网站试图阻止人工智能通过它们。 验证码的普及意味着狡猾的验证码更容易溜过。 皮尔斯表示，他“更期待在稍微危险的网站上”，但黑客“可以尝试劫持你的连接，这样当你尝试访问正常网站时你就会得到它”。 皮尔斯还表示，假冒验证码攻击的数量“目前已达到数百万”。 皮尔斯表示，现在犯罪分子利用一个人的互联网连接来攻击他们比以前要困难得多。 Pearce 表示，Chrome、Firefox 和 Edge 等主要浏览器已经使用了大量资源，使自己成为“计算机上最安全的技术”。 他说，如果验证码要求用户输入某些内容或离开窗口，用户应该保持怀疑。 “如果它实际上要求你在键盘上随机输入一些内容，你应该立即开始怀疑，”皮尔斯说。 “要非常警惕任何可能使您脱离网络浏览器安全的事物。” 他说，如果感觉有些不对劲，互联网用户应该问自己：“为什么？为什么我需要这样做？” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, particularly AI, presents both incredible opportunities and significant challenges. As Daniel foresaw, in the "end times," knowledge would increase. This surge in knowledge, while powerful, can be wielded for harm, as seen in these sophisticated scams targeting Australians. It calls for discernment and wisdom to navigate...
reflection.zh: 科技的飞速发展，特别是人工智能，既带来了巨大的机遇，也带来了严峻的挑战。正如但以理所预见的，“末世”之时，知识必增长。这种知识的激增，虽然强大，却可能被用于伤害，正如这些针对澳大利亚人的复杂骗局所显示的那样。它要求我们在不断变化的环境中保持辨别力和智慧。

verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Veena says there is one grandparenting arrangement she will 'never' commit to
title.zh: 维娜说有一种祖父母安排她永远不会承诺

summary.en: Experts note health benefits for grandparents providing childcare, but warn of a 'tipping point' where the demands may become detrimental. The story explores whether modern grandparents are physically and mentally well, or if their needs are being sacrificed for the younger generation.
summary.zh: 专家指出祖父母提供育儿服务有健康益处，但警告存在一个“临界点”，其需求可能对祖父母造成损害。故事探讨了现代祖父母的身体和精神是否健康，或者他们的需求是否为了年轻一代而被牺牲。

body.en:
What does grandparenting look like today? Insight explores whether the demands on modern-day grandparents are keeping them physically fit and mentally well, or if the younger generations’ wants and needs are being prioritised to the detriment of grandparents. Watch Insight episode Grandparenting Tuesday 8 September at 8.30pm on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Veena Gopinath recently became a grandmother to twins. When she found out her daughter was pregnant, Veena was excited for her, but not for herself.

"It wasn't a joyful instant emotion in any way, shape, or form," the 56-year-old told Insight.

The Sydney-based small business owner says her feelings about becoming a grandmother were strange.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"So, life was just becoming more fun for me — I had time and money and resources to look after myself."

When Veena became a mother 32 years ago, her parents put their lives on hold to help her adjust to motherhood.

"Both my parents came from India, and they stayed for 12 months ... I was totally pampered."

"That was the message I was given — to be a grandparent like that — and it was a really tough act to follow ..."

Deciding she didn't want to put herself through the same thing, Veena set clear boundaries with her daughter four months after she gave birth.

"If they want to go on a date night, I'll help them out because that's important for their marriage; and then if there are urgent or emergency things, of course I'll help."

"My view is that they need to find resources and create their own babysitting and money to handle those things. It's not my thing to help them out."

Myra Hamilton is a sociologist at the University of Sydney whose research focuses on gender, work and care.

She says that grandparents who set clear boundaries around what they're willing to do regarding childcare are less likely to experience negative impacts on their health and financial security. She says grandparents providing occasional or regular childcare has its benefits.

"[It] actually can be positive for grandparents' mental health, their mood; it can be positive for their physical health, their fitness or their balance or mobility; and some studies even find that it can be positive for cognitive health ..."

But the sociologist said there is a "tipping point" when it's no longer beneficial.

"Our own research has found what we call a tipping point of about 13 hours of childcare per week ..." she said.

"That's when you started to see things like they were less likely to say they felt they had a choice, they were more likely to feel obligated, they were less likely to enjoy providing the childcare."

title.en: Labor urges Greens, Coalition to pass social media reforms after 'dawdling and delay'
title.zh: 工党敦促绿党和联盟党通过社交媒体改革，指责其“拖延和耽搁”

summary.en: The government is pushing for legislation that would grant the eSafety Commissioner greater authority to collect data from social media platforms and impose higher penalties on tech companies that violate the ban on teen social media use. This push comes after investigations suggested major companies were exploiting...
summary.zh: 政府正推动立法，赋予eSafety专员更大的权力，以收集社交媒体平台的数据，并对违反青少年社交媒体禁令的科技公司处以更高的罚款。此前有调查显示，主要公司正在利用法律漏洞。

body.en:
Labor is urging the Greens and Coalition to pass laws that would strengthen the eSafety Commissioner's powers to gather information from social media companies and increase fines tech giants face for breaches of the teen social media ban.

When Labor introduced the bill in late June, Communications Minister Anika Wells said an eSafety investigation had suggested several major social media companies were exploiting loopholes in the law.

"The commissioner has found these companies adopting a number of dirty tricks to undermine Australia's law that are straight out of the big-tech playbook," Wells said at the time.

"It is clear ... that social media companies are deliberately failing to comply with our laws."

The bill would give the eSafety Commissioner enhanced information-gathering powers that Labor argues are necessary to ensure social media companies take 'reasonable steps' to prevent under-16s from creating or retaining social media accounts, as required under the ban.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In March-April, the eSafety Commissioner found 81.5 per cent of 10-15-year-olds were still using at least one age-restricted platform, a small decline from the 85.9 per cent it found before the ban came into effect on 10 December 2025.

However, the government has reported that more than five million social media accounts belonging to under-16s have been deleted, deactivated or restricted since the ban came into effect.

Meta — the parent company of Facebook and Instagram — said in mid-August that it had taken down more than 750,000 accounts and said those numbers would "continue to grow".

"We share the Australian government's goal of ensuring young people have safe, age-appropriate experiences online, and we are meeting our obligations under the law," the company added in a statement released at the time.

In early July, Greens and Coalition senators voted to send Labor's bill to a Senate inquiry, which eight weeks later recommended the reforms be adopted.

Wells said on Sunday that the decision to send the bill to an inquiry was "the kind of dawdling and delay that has enabled social media companies to get away with harming our kids for so long".

"We have to put politics to the side and pass this bill this week, so the eSafety Commissioner can hold social media companies accountable," she said.

When voting to refer the bill to the inquiry, Liberal Senator Sarah Henderson accused Labor of trying to "ram through" the new powers without proper scrutiny.

"Rather than Anika Wells' mad scramble to fix her broken ban, much more needs to be done to protect children online," she said.

This echoes the prophetic call for justice and ethical conduct, reminding us that even powerful digital platforms must be held to account for their impact on society, particularly on young...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚政府正寻求加强对社交媒体公司的监管，指出它们利用法律漏洞并需要承担更大的责任。这呼应了先知对公正和道德行为的呼唤，提醒我们即使是强大的数字平台也必须对其对社会，特别是对年轻人的影响负责。 弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，以及谦和地与我们的神同行。在此情境下，行公义意味着确保强大的科技公司在道德界限内运作，并为社会做出积极贡献，而不是利用弱点。

title.en: 'Titan of Australian sport': Boxer Tony Mundine honoured at heartfelt Redfern memorial
title.zh: 澳大利亚体育界的“巨人”：拳击手托尼·蒙迪内在一场感人的雷德芬纪念仪式上受到表彰

summary.en: From boxing rings to Redfern's Block, Anthony 'Tony' Mundine's impact and memory remain unmatched.
summary.zh: 从拳击擂台到雷德芬的街区，安东尼·“托尼”·蒙迪内的影响和记忆依然无与伦比。

body.en:
WARNING: This article contains the name and image of an Aboriginal person who has passed away.

Respected Bundjalung boxer Anthony 'Tony' Mundine OAM has been remembered as an "unwavering anchor" of strength and determination at an emotional ceremony in Sydney's Redfern.

Crowds gathered at Redfern Oval on Saturday morning to pay their respects to Mundine, who died from a heart attack on 30 August — aged 75.

His coffin was carried to a small stage — decorated with a large bouquet and the Aboriginal flag proudly draped across the top.

On the side, the dark wood was printed with a pair of boxing gloves and a gold rabbit, a nod to Mundine's loyal, lifelong love of the South Sydney Rabbitohs.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Bundjalung and Gadigal man Craig Madden, nephew to "Uncle Tony", welcomed guests to Country.

He recalled the life of a man who, at 15, came to Sydney to chase his dreams "into the ring".

"Steady, loyal and always there when you needed him. He was strong and staunch, yet humble, kind and generous beyond measure," he said.

"He always made room for a yarn and a laugh, or a quiet word when someone needed comfort."

"He was not a man who wasted words; the ones he shared carried wisdom, warmth and strength ... he shared lessons about life that stayed with you —leaving you feeling hopeful, grounded and ready to face what was to come next."

He reflected on Mundine's "quiet resilience, unwavering integrity and deep strength of character" that saw him become a "titan of Australian sport".

Acknowledging the legend's achievements in the ring, Mundine Jr said his "greatest victory" was the establishment of the Elouera Tony Mundine Gym and the Tony Mundine Hostel.

"He built far more than physical places — he built sanctuaries of hope," said Mundine Jr.

"For generations of community and young people, especially Aboriginal youth seeking direction, safe housing or a second chance, Tony offered a home away from home."

A "steady anchor", Mundine was a "deeply devoted" family man and a "loyal and steadfast" friend.

"Your fight may be done, but your victories are eternal — and your legacy will never fade."

Mundine's four children, Kelly, Natalie, Anthony and Kiah, also paid tribute to their father.

His youngest child, Kiah Tony Mundine Atkins, described her father as "positive, friendly, kind and happy", a man who "loved people" and deeply loved his grandchildren.

She recalled his cheekiness, his pride in his bright red car he constantly washed, and his funny sayings, "stone the crows, and everybody was a cowboy".

reflection.en: The passing of Anthony 'Tony' Mundine, a respected figure in Australian sport and community, reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that 'man is destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.' His memorial service in Redfern, attended by many, reflects the deep impact he had and the...
reflection.zh: 备受尊敬的澳大利亚体育界和社区人士安东尼·“托尼”·蒙迪内（Anthony 'Tony' Mundine）的离世，提醒我们人类共同经历的必死性。希伯来书9:27谈到这一现实，指出“人人都有一死，死后且有审判”。他在雷德芬举行的追悼仪式，有众多人士参加，反映了他产生的深远影响，以及人们在生命和失落中所共同经历的旅程。

summary.zh: 香港金融管理局（HKMA）周一就香港可持续金融分类法的下一阶段发展展开公众咨询，旨在扩大绿色和转型活动的定义。该分类法旨在为绿色和可持续活动提供清晰、透明的定义，以期扩大资本流动规模，同时解决对“漂绿”的担忧。第二阶段B原型增加了10项新的经济活动，并对部分第二阶段A活动进行了重新分类，使总数从25项增至39项，并为绿...

body.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) launched on Monday a public consultation on the next phase of development of the Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance as the city moves to expand definitions for green and transition activities. The taxonomy is designed to provide clear, transparent definitions for what constitutes green and sustainable activities with the aim of scaling up capital flows while addressing greenwashing concerns, the HKMA said. Phase 2B prototype adds 10 new economic activities that, together with the recategorisation of some phase 2A activities, brings the total from 25 to 39 and introduces technical criteria for both green and transition measures. The updates focus on enabling technologies such as battery manufacturing and recycling, as well as low-carbon technologies. They also provide transition pathways for hard-to-abate sectors, including air transport and iron and steel. The prototype also enhances the methodology for climate-change adaptation by introducing a process-based approach, given the location-specific nature of such measures. The initial focus is on shoreline protection and flood management, which are closely tied to key climate risks facing Hong Kong. The consultation runs until October 7. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 随着香港扩大绿色和转型活动的定义，香港金融管理局（金管局）周一就香港可持续金融分类法的下一阶段发展展开公众咨询。金管局表示，该分类法旨在为绿色和可持续活动的构成提供清晰、透明的定义，旨在扩大资本流动，同时解决洗绿问题。 2B 阶段原型增加了 10 项新经济活动，再加上 2A 阶段一些活动的重新分类，使总数从 25 项增加到 39 项，并引入了绿色和过渡措施的技术标准。更新的重点是电池制造和回收等支持技术以及低碳技术。它们还为航空运输和钢铁等难以减排的行业提供转型途径。考虑到此类措施的具体地点性质，该原型还通过引入基于过程的方法来增强气候变化适应的方法。最初的重点是海岸线保护和洪水管理，这与香港面临的主要气候风险密切相关。咨询持续至 10 月 7 日。Edmond Fong 编辑

This process of defining clear criteria for green activities reflects a commitment to thoughtful development and responsible stewardship of resources. It echoes the wisdom of entrusting one's plans to a higher power, seeking...
reflection.zh: 香港金融管理局就其可持续金融分类法展开咨询，标志着一项重要的规划工作。这一为绿色活动定义清晰标准的进程，体现了对周密发展和负责任地管理资源的承诺。这呼应了将计划交托于更高力量，寻求指导以实现有影响力和可持续成果的智慧。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 'More jab options available as HK sees flu peak'
title.zh: 香港流感高峰期提供更多疫苗选择

summary.en: Hong Kong is currently experiencing a peak in seasonal flu cases. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau emphasized on Monday that vaccination is the most effective method to protect vulnerable populations. He made this appeal after he and other health officials received their seasonal flu vaccinations. The government has...
summary.zh: 香港目前正经历季节性流感高峰期。卫生局局长卢宠茂周一强调，接种疫苗是保护弱势群体的最有效方法。他在与卫生官员一同接种季节性流感疫苗后发表了此番呼吁。政府已为今年的疫苗接种计划采购了130万剂疫苗，首批已运抵香港。当局已采取多项改进措施，包括加强疫苗采购安排，以确保疫苗供应的可持续性，并已购买不同种类的疫苗。

body.en: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau on Monday said Hong Kong is facing a flu peak, and the most effective way to protect the vulnerable groups is through vaccination. Lo made the appeal as he and health officials received the seasonal flu vaccination at Sai Wan Ho Family Medicine Clinic. Speaking to the media after getting the jab, Lo said the government has procured 1.3 million vaccine doses for this year’s vaccination programme, with the first batch already arrived in the city. He said the authorities have adopted various improvement measures, including enhancing the vaccine procurement arrangement, to ensure sustainable jab supply. Authorities have purchased different types of vaccines – inactivated, recombinant and nasal spray live attenuated jabs – to cater to the needs of different groups, he said. “Our school outreach programme for students under 18 offers more options, including the nasal spray live attenuated flu vaccine,” Lo said. “Schools now can choose the vaccine type they want, and if they require both injectable inactivated vaccines and nasal spray jabs, we can send medics to the school to offer both options at the same time, so that all parents can choose their preferred vaccination method.” The health minister added the authorities have also introduced digital consent forms for flu vaccination, and will further promote vaccination in the community. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 卫生局局长罗仲茂周一表示，香港正面临流感高峰，保护弱势群体最有效的方法是接种疫苗。卢先生和卫生官员在西湾河家庭医学诊所接受季节性流感疫苗接种时发出上述呼吁。卢先生在接种疫苗后接受媒体采访时表示，政府已为今年的疫苗接种计划采购了130万剂疫苗，第一批已运抵香港。他说，当局已采取各种改善措施，包括加强疫苗采购安排，以确保可持续的疫苗供应。他说，当局购买了不同类型的疫苗——灭活疫苗、重组疫苗和鼻喷雾减毒疫苗——以满足不同群体的需求。 “我们为 18 岁以下学生提供的学校外展计划提供了更多选择，包括鼻喷雾减毒流感疫苗，”Lo 说。 “学校现在可以选择他们想要的疫苗类型，如果他们需要注射灭活疫苗和鼻喷雾疫苗，我们可以派医务人员到学校同时提供两种选择，以便所有家长可以选择他们喜欢的疫苗接种方式。”卫生部长补充说，当局还引入了流感疫苗接种的数字同意书，并将进一步在社区推广疫苗接种。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong grapples with a surge in flu cases, the call for vaccination underscores a fundamental human and spiritual responsibility: caring for the vulnerable. The proactive steps taken by health officials, including receiving the vaccine themselves, reflect a commitment to safeguarding the community. This echoes the biblical call to tend to the sick and...
reflection.zh: 随着香港正努力应对流感病例的激增，呼吁接种疫苗的行为凸显了一项基本的人类和属灵责任：关怀弱势群体。卫生官员采取的积极措施，包括他们自己接种疫苗，体现了保护社区的承诺。这呼应了圣经中通过实际行动照顾病患、保护高危人群的呼召，认识到集体的福祉是一项共同的努力。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: HK 'can play wider super connector role in C Asia'
title.zh: 香港可在中亚扮演更广泛的超级联系人角色

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive, John Lee, stated on Monday that the city is fully committed to strengthening its partnerships with Central Asian nations. He expressed Hong Kong's ambition to enhance its function as a 'super connector' within the framework of the Belt and Road Initiative. Lee highlighted the significant...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超周一表示，香港完全致力于深化与中亚国家的伙伴关系，并表示该市旨在根据“一带一路”倡议扩大其作为“超级联系人”的作用。李家超在阿斯塔纳举行的南华早报中国会议上通过视频致辞时表示，香港与中亚之间商品贸易的增长是贸易和投资关系日益深化的明确证明。他指出，去年香港与中亚之间的商品贸易总额超过3.24亿美元，比...

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said on Monday Hong Kong is fully committed to furthering its partnership with Central Asian countries, saying the city aims to expand its role as a "super connector" under the Belt and Road Initiative. Speaking via video at the South China Morning Post's China Conference in Astana, he said increasing merchandise trade between Hong Kong and Central Asia is a clear testament to deepening trade and investment ties. "Last year, the total merchandise trade between Hong Kong and Central Asia amounted to over US$324 million, representing a solid increase of 27 percent as compared to 2020," Lee said. "It is a clear testament to our deepening trade and investment ties, and we are fully committed to taking this partnership even further." Lee said the SAR's unique advantages under "one country, two systems", including its common law system, low taxes and multicultural talent, make it an ideal gateway for Central Asian businesses to access the vast Chinese mainland market. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周一表示，香港全力致力于深化与中亚国家的伙伴关系，并表示香港的目标是扩大其作为“一带一路”倡议下“超级联系人”的角色。他在阿斯塔纳举行的《南华早报》中国会议上通过视频发表讲话时表示，香港与中亚之间的商品贸易不断增加，清楚地证明了贸易和投资关系的深化。李说：“去年，香港与中亚之间的商品贸易总额超过3.24亿美元，较2020年大幅增长27%。” “这清楚地证明了我们不断深化的贸易和投资关系，我们完全致力于进一步推动这种伙伴关系。”李显龙表示，特区在“一国两制”下的独特优势，包括普通法体系、低税收和多元文化人才，使其成为中亚企业进入广阔的中国内地市场的理想门户。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The Chief Executive's vision for Hong Kong to act as a 'super connector' between Central Asia and the wider world speaks to the human desire for connection and prosperity. As leaders and nations pursue such ambitious goals, the ancient wisdom of committing one's endeavors to a higher power offers a foundation for hope and integrity. May all undertakings be...
reflection.zh: 行政长官关于香港在中亚与世界之间扮演“超级联系人”角色的愿景，体现了人类对连接和繁荣的渴望。当领导人和国家追求如此宏伟的目标时，将一切努力托付于更高力量的古老智慧，为希望和正直提供了基础。愿所有事业都以促进互利和持久和平的原则为指导。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Two arrested for alleged illegal import of pests
title.zh: 两人因涉嫌非法进口害虫被捕

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs announced on Monday the seizure of 200 live crickets and 13 kilograms of dubia roaches in two separate incidents at the Lo Wu control point. A 71-year-old man was arrested on Saturday with live crickets in his luggage, and a 66-year-old woman was stopped the following day with live dubia roaches....
summary.zh: 香港海关周一宣布，在罗湖管制站的两起事件中查获了200只活蟋蟀和13公斤杜比亚蟑螂。一名71岁男子周六因行李中藏有活蟋蟀被捕，一名66岁女子次日因携带活杜比亚蟑螂被截获。两人均被逮捕，案件已转交渔农自然护理署跟进调查。

body.en: Customs said on Monday they have seized 200 live crickets and 13 kilograms of dubia roaches in two suspected cases of illegally importing live plant pests at the Lo Wu control point. Officers intercepted a 71-year-old man at the arrival hall on Saturday and found the batch of live crickets, with an estimated market value of about HK$2,000, in his baggage. A day later, a 66-year-old woman was stopped and had a batch of live dubia roaches, with an estimated market value of about HK$3,900, seized. Both were arrested, with their cases handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for follow-up investigations. Customs said importing any plant pest or any plant infected or infested by such vermin without prior authorisation issued by the director of agriculture, fisheries and conservation is an offence, and any person found guilty of that is liable to a fine of up to HK$10,000 and imprisonment for six months. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 海关周一表示，在罗湖管制站查获两起怀疑非法进口活植物害虫案件，共检获200只活蟋蟀及13公斤蟑螂。海关人员周六在入境大堂截查一名71岁男子，并在其行李内发现该批活蟋蟀，估计市值约2,000港元。一天后，一名66岁女子被截查，并检获一批活蟑螂，估计市值约港币3,900元。两人均被捕，案件已交由渔农自然护理署跟进调查。海关表示，未经渔农自然护理署署长事先批准，进口任何植物病虫害或受该害虫感染或侵染的植物，即属违法，任何人一经定罪，最高可被罚款港币10,000元及监禁六个月。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The meticulous work of customs officers in intercepting illegal imports, like the crickets and roaches, underscores a commitment to upholding regulations that safeguard ecological balance and public health. This dedication to proper procedure and the protection of the common good resonates with the call to act justly and with integrity in all our...
reflection.zh: 海关官员一丝不苟地截获非法进口物品，如蟋蟀和蟑螂，这体现了他们维护法规、保护生态平衡和公众健康的承诺。这种对正当程序和公共利益的奉献，与我们在所有责任中秉持公义和诚信行事的呼召相呼应。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Make home ownership a 5-year plan goal, Legco president says
title.zh: 立法会主席称购房应成为五年规划目标

summary.en: Hong Kong Legislative Council president Starry Lee Wai-king has proposed making increased home ownership a key objective in the city's upcoming five-year plan. This suggestion follows a visit to a public housing estate with the housing minister and includes ideas like reviving a scheme for public housing tenants to...
summary.zh: 香港特区政府应将提高房屋拥有率作为首个五年规划的目标，立法会主席李慧琼在与房屋局局长一同视察公共屋邨后表示。李慧琼还提出，可以通过重振允许公屋住户购买其单位的计划，并将资助房屋优先分配给青年和中产家庭来实现这一目标。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities should make raising home ownership a goal of the city’s first five-year plan, Legislative Council president Starry Lee Wai-king has said, following a visit to a public estate with the housing minister. Lee also said the goal could be achieved by reviving a scheme that allowed public housing tenants to buy their flats and reserving subsidised homes for youth and middle-class families. She made the remarks after inspecting Oi Man Estate in Ho Man Tin with Housing Bureau and...
body.zh: 立法会主席李惠琼在与住房部长参观一处公共地产后表示，香港当局应将提高住房自有率作为该市第一个五年计划的目标。李还表示，这一目标可以通过恢复一项允许公屋租户购买公寓并为青年和中产阶级家庭保留补贴住房的计划来实现。她是在与房屋局视察何文田爱民村后发表上述言论的。

reflection.en: The call to make home ownership a five-year plan goal in Hong Kong highlights the government's role in addressing citizens' fundamental needs. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds leaders that their mandate includes 'executing justice and righteousness' and protecting the vulnerable, a principle that resonates with efforts to ensure housing accessibility for families.
reflection.zh: 将提高房屋拥有率作为香港五年规划目标之一的呼吁，凸显了政府在满足市民基本需求方面的作用。耶利米书22:3提醒领导者，他们的职责包括“施行公平和公义”，并保护弱势群体，这一原则与确保家庭住房可负担性的努力产生了共鸣。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hong Kong a ‘trusted partner’ to drive Central Asia growth, city leader says
title.zh: 香港领导人称香港是推动中亚增长的“值得信赖的伙伴”

summary.en: Hong Kong's leader stated the city is committed to being a "trusted partner" in fostering Central Asia's growth, citing substantial outcomes from a recent regional mission. A bank involved in the mission has since provided US$785 million to the Development Bank of Kazakhstan.
summary.zh: 香港领导人表示，该市致力于成为推动中亚增长的“值得信赖的伙伴”，并提到了最近一次区域任务取得的丰硕成果。参与此次任务的一家银行此后向哈萨克斯坦开发银行提供了 7.85 亿美元。

body.en: Hong Kong is committed to being a “trusted partner” in driving Central Asia’s emergence as a global growth engine, according to the city’s leader, who hailed the substantial outcomes achieved since his landmark mission to the region. In a virtual appearance at the South China Morning Post’s China Conference: Central Asia 2026 held in Astana on Monday, Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said that a bank in his June delegation had since backed the Development Bank of Kazakhstan with US$785 million...
body.zh: 香港领导人表示，香港致力于成为推动中亚成为全球增长引擎的“值得信赖的合作伙伴”，并赞扬自他访问该地区以来取得的重大成果。周一，在阿斯塔纳举行的《南华早报》中国会议：2026年中亚会议上，首席执行官李家超表示，其六月代表团中的一家银行此后向哈萨克斯坦开发银行提供了7.85亿美元的支持……

reflection.en: The Chief Executive's announcement of Hong Kong's role as a "trusted partner" in Central Asia's economic development, backed by substantial financial commitments like the US$785 million loan, reflects a strategic vision for growth. This endeavor, when undertaken with integrity and a commitment to shared prosperity, aligns with the principle of entrusting...
reflection.zh: 香港行政长官宣布香港将作为“值得信赖的伙伴”在中亚经济发展中发挥作用，并得到了 7.85 亿美元贷款等实质性财政承诺的支持，这体现了一种战略性的增长愿景。这项事业，如果以诚信和对共同繁荣的承诺来执行，就符合将工作交托给更高力量以求成功的原则。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: 2 Hong Kong travel agencies, guide stripped of licences over ‘coerced shopping’
title.zh: 香港两旅行社、一名导游因“强制购物”被吊销执照

summary.en: Hong Kong's tourism authority has revoked the licenses of two travel agencies and one tour guide for failing to protect mainland Chinese tourists from 'coerced shopping.' The Travel Industry Authority stated its zero-tolerance policy against such practices that harm the city's reputation.
summary.zh: 香港旅游业监管机构吊销了两家旅行社和一名导游的执照，原因是他们未能保护中国大陆游客免受“强制购物”的侵害。旅游业管理局表示，对损害香港声誉的此类行为采取零容忍政策。

body.en: Hong Kong’s tourism watchdog has revoked the licences of two travel agencies and a guide after finding they failed to protect members of mainland Chinese tour groups from “coerced shopping”. The Travel Industry Authority said on Monday that the licences of Go Go Ming Travel Services, Grandee Travel Company and guide Sun Kwun-ying were revoked with immediate effect. “The authority adopts a zero-tolerance approach towards coerced shopping and any conduct that damages the reputation of Hong Kong’s...
body.zh: 香港旅游监管机构发现两家旅行社和一名导游未能保护中国大陆旅游团成员免遭“强迫购物”，因此吊销了它们的执照。旅游业监管局周一表示，高高明旅行社、君帝旅游公司及导游孙冠英的牌照已即时撤销。 “当局对强迫购物和任何损害香港声誉的行为采取零容忍态度......

reflection.en: The Travel Industry Authority's decision to revoke licenses for 'coerced shopping' highlights a commitment to justice and ethical tourism. It's a reminder that integrity in business dealings is paramount, protecting vulnerable visitors and upholding the reputation of Hong Kong.
reflection.zh: 旅游业管理局吊销因“强制购物”而执照的决定，凸显了对公正和道德旅游业的承诺。这提醒我们，商业往来的诚信至关重要，要保护弱势游客并维护香港的声誉。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: HK 'to scale up green drive with capital accelerator'
title.zh: 香港将通过资本加速器扩大绿色发展

summary.en: Hong Kong is set to launch the 'Green Accelerator' initiative, aimed at transforming green technologies into scalable and investable projects. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui announced that this program will direct private capital to climate solutions and create opportunities for Hong...
summary.zh: 香港将推出“绿色加速器”计划，旨在将绿色技术转化为可投资和可扩展的项目。财经事务及库务局局长许正宇宣布，该计划将引导私人资本流向气候解决方案，并通过解决投资准备就绪的绿色项目短缺问题，为香港专业服务界创造机遇。

body.en: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui on Monday said a new initiative to turn green technologies into investable and scalable projects, the Green Accelerator, would be launched later in the day. Speaking at the 2026 Hong Kong Green Finance Association and Greater Bay Area Green Finance Alliance Annual Forum, he said the accelerator initiative would channel private capital towards climate solutions where it is most needed, while creating new opportunities for Hong Kong's professional services. "By providing systematic pre-finance support and project structuring, it addresses a critical bottleneck: the shortage of investment-ready green projects," Hui said. Many Belt and Road economies, he pointed out, require substantial financing for green development and climate resilience. "The transition to a low-carbon future is not a destination to be reached by a single route," Hui said. "Different countries or stakeholders are going through diverse journeys, with different starting points and also different challenges. "Hong Kong's commitment is to be a facilitator, a connector and a partner in the process. "We will continue to deepen our collaboration with the mainland, the Greater Bay Area, and the international community, mobilising capital, sharing expertise and building resilience." Hui said Hong Kong has been at the forefront of facilitating green investment and sustainable infrastructure development across participating economies, leveraging the SAR's deep capital markets and professional expertise to structure bankable projects and de-risk investments. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 财经事务及库务局局长许正宇周一表示，将于当天晚些时候启动一项将绿色技术转化为可投资和可扩展项目的新举措“绿色加速器”。他在2026年香港绿色金融协会暨大湾区绿色金融联盟年度论坛上发表讲话时表示，加速器计划将引导私人资本投向最需要的气候解决方案，同时为香港的专业服务创造新机遇。 “通过提供系统的前期融资支持和项目结构，它解决了一个关键瓶颈：可投资的绿色项目的短缺，”许说。他指出，许多“一带一路”经济体需要大量融资来促进绿色发展和气候适应能力。许说：“向低碳未来的过渡不是通过单一途径就能到达的目的地。” “不同的国家或利益相关者正在经历不同的旅程，起点不同，挑战也不同。香港承诺成为这一过程的推动者、联络者和伙伴。” “我们将继续深化与内地、大湾区和国际社会的合作，动员资本、分享专业知识和增强韧性。”许表示，香港在促进参与经济体的绿色投资和可持续基础设施发展方面一直走在前列，利用香港深厚的资本市场和专业知识来构建可融资的项目并降低投资风险。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The launch of the Green Accelerator in Hong Kong signifies a deliberate effort to mobilize resources for environmental solutions. It echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 16:3, which encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that our plans will succeed through His favor. May this initiative be guided by wisdom and integrity, fostering genuine...
reflection.zh: 香港推出“绿色加速器”计划，标志着一项为环境解决方案调动资源的有意识的努力。这呼应了箴言16:3的智慧，该经文鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，并相信我们的计划将因祂的恩惠而得以成就。愿这项计划在智慧和正直的引导下，为地球带来真正的进步。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Ride-hailing giant Didi Chuxing to apply to test driverless vehicles in Hong Kong
title.zh: 滴滴出行将在香港申请测试自动驾驶汽车

summary.en: Didi Chuxing, a major Chinese ride-hailing company, plans to apply for permission to test autonomous vehicles in an urban area of Hong Kong this year. This initiative, revealed by a government adviser, could eventually expand to cover more new development zones. The announcement follows a visit by the Secretary for...
summary.zh: 中国网约车巨头滴滴出行今年将申请在香港一城市地区测试自动驾驶汽车，政府顾问透露。此次试运行可能随后扩展到覆盖更多新开发区。此消息传出之际，运输及物流局局长陈帆与立法会议员一行人于上周三访问了滴滴北京总部。

body.en: Mainland Chinese ride-hailing giant Didi Chuxing will apply to test autonomous vehicles in a Hong Kong urban area this year, a government adviser has revealed, with the trial runs potentially being expanded later on to cover more new development areas. The announcement followed a visit to Didi’s Beijing headquarters last Wednesday by Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan and a group of lawmakers. Gary Zhang Xinyu, a member of the Transport Department’s working group for promoting...
body.zh: 一位政府顾问透露，中国内地网约车巨头滴滴出行今年将申请在香港市区测试自动驾驶汽车，试运行稍后可能会扩大到覆盖更多新开发区域。此前，运输及物流局局长陈美宝和一群议员上周三访问了滴滴北京总部，随后宣布了这一消息。交通运输部推广工作小组成员张新宇

reflection.en: As Didi Chuxing prepares to test autonomous vehicles in Hong Kong, it embarks on a significant technological and business endeavor. This venture calls for careful planning and execution, entrusting the work to a higher power for guidance and success. May their efforts be guided by wisdom and a commitment to safety and the public good.
reflection.zh: 随着滴滴出行准备在香港测试自动驾驶汽车，它正踏上一项重大的技术和商业事业。这项事业需要周密的规划和执行，并祈求更高的力量指引和成功。愿他们的努力以智慧为指导，并致力于安全和公共利益。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 3 re-arrested for alleged sedition after marking anniversary of 2019 Prince Edward police storming
title.zh: 三人因纪念2019年太子地铁站事件涉嫌煽动罪被重新逮捕

summary.en: Police have re-arrested three people on suspicion of sedition, after previously apprehending them outside Prince Edward station on the anniversary of a 2019 incident when police stormed MTR trains on the platform. Authorities stated the trio were arrested on suspicion of 'doing an act that has a seditious intention...
summary.zh: 警方以涉嫌煽动罪重新逮捕了三人，此前他们曾在2019年警方冲进太子站列车的事件周年纪念日之际，在太子站外被拘留。当局表示，这三人因持有花束和喊口号，涉嫌“怀有煽动意图而作出煽动行为”而被国家安全部门逮捕。

body.en: Police have re-arrested three people on suspicion of sedition, after previously apprehending them outside Prince Edward station on the anniversary of a 2019 incident when police stormed MTR trains on the platform. Prince Edward MTR station on August 31, 2019. Photo: May James/HKFP. In an official statement issued Saturday, authorities said the trio were arrested by the National Security Department on Thursday on suspicion of “doing an act that has a seditious intention with a seditious intention.” “Police noticed that on the evening of August 31, some people were standing outside MTR Prince Edward Station holding bouquets and shouting seditious slogans,” the statement read. Those arrested were “suspected of spreading false information,” as well as attacking and smearing the government and the police force, it added. The three people – two men and one woman aged between 33 and 79 – were initially arrested near Prince Edward MTR station on Monday last week. They had gone to the station to mark seven years since the “831 incident,” or the “August 31 incident.” On that date in 2019, baton-wielding riot police stormed Prince Edward MTR station following hours of protest clashes. Officers were filmed pepper-spraying people in carriages as they drove away reporters and medics. The Hong Kong Police Force headquarters in Wan Chai. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Discrepancies in official records of injuries and the closure of the station fuelled unverified rumours of civilian deaths. The police watchdog largely cleared the force of wrongdoing but faced criticism for lacking independence and investigatory powers in its probe. According to the Saturday statement, “police stressed that the so-called ‘831 incident’… is a lie manipulated by persons with ulterior motives to spread lies, attack the HKSAR Government and smear the Police Force.” Local media have reported that one of the arrestees is Virginia Fung, a pro-democracy district councillor who served from 1994 to the 2007. She was convicted and imprisoned in 2006 for rental allowance fraud, and subsequently barred from sitting on the local council again. Sedition is an offence under Hong Kong’s local security law, also known as Article 23. Offenders face up to seven years in prison if convicted.
body.zh: 警方在 2019 年警方袭击港铁站台事件周年纪念日期间，在太子站外逮捕了三名涉嫌煽动叛乱的人。 2019 年 8 月 31 日的太子地铁站。照片：May James/HKFP。当局在周六发布的一份官方声明中表示，这三人于周四被国家安全部逮捕，罪名是“从事具有煽动意图的煽动行为”。声明称：“警方注意到，8月31日晚，有人手持花束站在港铁太子站外，并高喊煽动性口号。”声明补充说，被捕者“涉嫌传播虚假信息”，以及攻击和抹黑政府和警察部队。这三人——两男一女，年龄介乎33至79岁——最初于上周周一在太子地铁站附近被捕。他们去车站纪念“831事件”或“8月31事件”七周年。 2019 年的这一天，在持续数小时的抗议冲突后，挥舞警棍的防暴警察袭击了太子地铁站。警察在赶走记者和医务人员时，拍摄到警察向车厢内的人们喷胡椒喷雾。香港警务处总部位于湾仔。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。官方受伤记录和车站关闭的差异助长了未经证实的平民死亡谣言。警方监管机构基本上清除了不法行为，但因调查缺乏独立性和调查权力而面临批评。周六的声明称，“警方强调，所谓‘831事件’……是别有用心的人操纵的谎言，散布谎言、攻击香港特区政府、抹黑警队。”当地媒体报道称，其中一名被捕者是民主派区议员冯维琪，曾于1994年至2007年任职。她于2006年因租金津贴欺诈被定罪入狱，随后被禁止再次担任当地议会议员。根据香港地方安全法（也称为第 23 条），煽动叛乱属于犯罪行为。如果罪名成立，罪犯将面临最高七年的监禁。

reflection.en: The news describes individuals re-arrested for sedition after marking an anniversary with flowers and slogans. This situation highlights the ongoing tension and the cycle of actions and reactions. Romans 12:21 reminds us, 'Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.' This calls for a response that breaks the cycle, seeking a path beyond mere...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻报道了三名人士因在纪念日手持花束和口号而被以煽动罪重新逮捕。这一情况凸显了持续的紧张局势以及行动与反应的循环。罗马书12章21节提醒我们：“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。”这呼吁我们采取一种打破循环的回应，寻求超越单纯的对抗或报复的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Philanthropic giving in Asia forecast to hit US$1.5 trillion over next decade
title.zh: 亚洲慈善捐赠预计未来十年将达到1.5万亿美元

summary.en: Philanthropic giving across nine Asian jurisdictions is projected to reach US$1.5 trillion over the next decade. A new report, released at a Jockey Club forum, indicates that corporate contributions are playing a more substantial role in Hong Kong compared to many other regional centers. The Hong Kong Jockey Club...
summary.zh: 亚洲九个司法管辖区的慈善捐赠预计在未来十年将达到1.5万亿美元。在赛马会论坛上发布的一份新报告显示，与许多区域中心相比，香港的企业捐赠发挥着更重要的作用。香港赛马会慈善信托基金本身就贡献了该市约1.8%的国内生产总值。

body.en: Philanthropic giving in nine Asian jurisdictions is projected to hit US$1.5 trillion over the next decade, while corporate contributions play a larger role in Hong Kong than in many regional peers, according to a new report released at a Jockey Club forum. The Commission on Asian Philanthropy released its interim report on Monday, while the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust revealed in a separate report that it had contributed around 1.8 per cent of the city’s gross domestic product (GDP) in...
body.zh: 根据赛马会论坛上发布的一份新报告，未来十年，九个亚洲司法管辖区的慈善捐赠预计将达到 1.5 万亿美元，而企业捐款在香港的作用比许多地区同行更大。亚洲慈善委员会周一发布了中期报告，而香港赛马会慈善信托基金在另一份报告中透露，该信托基金在 2017 年为香港国内生产总值 (GDP) 做出了约 1.8% 的贡献。

reflection.en: This projection of US$1.5 trillion in Asian philanthropy over the next decade is a remarkable testament to human generosity and the potential for positive impact. It speaks to the principle of committing our endeavors, whether individual or corporate, to a higher purpose, trusting that our work, when dedicated, can be blessed and yield fruit for the good of...
reflection.zh: 亚洲未来十年1.5万亿美元的慈善捐赠预测，是对人类慷慨和产生积极影响潜力的显著证明。它体现了将我们的努力，无论是个人还是企业的，都奉献给更高目的的原则，相信我们的工作，一旦奉献，就能得到祝福并为许多人的福祉带来成果。
